scope: Standalone native workspace broker over SOCK_SEQPACKET
checks: A 1 MiB request returned the actual short file length, with a 4096-byte first packet and a 29-byte last packet. EOF returned zero without a pending transfer.
After fork the child observed the fully advanced shared OFD offset and had no inherited transfer. Subsequent mutation did not change buffered NEXT bytes.
A positioned request observed the new file byte without moving the shared offset. Invalid limits, offset overflow, mode, payload, directory and bad FD were rejected.
A second BEGIN and malformed NEXT/ABORT did not overwrite the snapshot. ABORT was idempotent, and closing a fork session with an undrained transfer allowed broker completion.
